The available tools do not directly support calculating the area of objects (like basketball courts) from a satellite image using Ground Sampling Distance (GSD). While tools like `geo_perception__sam2_segment` can segment objects in the image, there is no function provided to extract pixel counts or convert pixel dimensions to real-world areas using GSD. 1. Segment the basketball courts using `geo_perception__sam2_segment` or similar tools.
2. Count the pixels of each court.
3. Multiply pixel counts by $ \text{GSD}^2 $ (e.g., $ 0.146^2 $) to get the area in square meters.
